marks.gloss_en: an incident in the days of R' Chalafta and R' Chananya ben Teradyon: one passed before the ark and finished the whole blessing, and they did not answer amen after him
when the matter came before the Sages they said: we did not practise so except at the Eastern Gate and on the Temple Mount
R' Yehoshua: on the first three fasts the men of the watch fast but do not complete
the Sages: on the first three neither group fasts at all -- the men of the watch included
the men of the watch may drink wine at night
every [day] written in Megillat Taanit as 'not to eulogise' -- the day before is forbidden [for eulogy]
'not to fast' [days]: the day before is permitted [for fasting]
one does not decree a fast on the community beginning on a Thursday
one does not decree a fast on the community on New Moons, on Chanuka or on Purim
איני? והתניא, רבי אומר: בקללה מתחילין מן הקטן -- ashes on a fast are a matter of curse, yet the mishnah begins with the Nasi
Rebbi: in greatness one begins with the greatest
הא חשיבותא לדידהו: going first is, for them, a distinction -- 'you are worthy to ask mercy for us all' (= p_chashivuta_ledidhu)
this is a distinction for them, for [the people] say to them: you are worthy to ask mercy for us all
in greatness one begins with the greatest, as it says 'and Moses said to Aharon and to Elazar and to Itamar' (Lev 10:6)
the mishna (cited as lemma): each and every one puts [ashes] on his own head
ואפילו בקמייתא? ורמינהו: the mishnah's ark ritual is unqualified, but the baraita has the first and second sets pray in the synagogue as all year, and the ark taken out only on the last seven
the baraita: on the first and second three fasts they enter the synagogue and pray as they pray all year
כי תנן נמי מתניתין — אשבע אחרונות תנן: the mishnah too speaks of the last seven (= p_pappa_acharonot_tnan)
and on the last seven they take the ark out to the city square and put ashes on the ark, on the head of the Nasi and of the av beit din, and each one takes and puts [ashes] on his own head
